extracted.intended_audience: hospital administrators, health system finance and quality staff, EHR vendors, organ procurement organizations, long-term care and acute care hospital stakeholders, and other Medicare program participants and commenters
extracted.subtask_description: Extracted standards and program-specific proposals from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services FY2027 proposed rule (IPPS and LTCH PPS) covering payment updates, quality programs, Promoting Interoperability, CJR‑X, TEAM, organ acquisition policies, data sharing, ICRs, and public comment procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal To End the Public Display of the COVID-19 Vaccine: Percent of Patients/Residents Who Are Up to Date Measure
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal To End the Public Display of the COVID-19 Vaccine: Percent of Patients/Residents Who Are Up to Date Measure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears in table of contents as a proposed change to quality/public display requirements (linked to LTCH QRP and other quality reporting programs); specifics and implementation timing are proposed within relevant program sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Changes to the Medicare Promoting Interoperability Program
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals to update the Medicare Promoting Interoperability Program for eligible hospitals and Critical Access Hospitals (CAHs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes statutory authority discussion, ONC Health IT Certification Program updates relevant to the program, and multiple measure-level proposals (e.g., remove attestations, modify measures).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory Authority for the Medicare Promoting Interoperability Program for Eligible Hospitals and CAHs
rubrics_metrics.description: Discussion of the statutory authority underlying the Medicare Promoting Interoperability Program for eligible hospitals and CAHs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames the legal basis for program changes and proposed regulatory amendments; relevant for assessing whether proposed changes align with statutory mandates.

rubrics_metrics.name: ONC Health IT Certification Program Proposed Updates Relevant to the Medicare Promoting Interoperability Program
rubrics_metrics.description: Background and proposed updates to the definition of Certified Electronic Health Record Technology (CEHRT) and related ONC certification program requirements as they affect the Promoting Interoperability Program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes proposed modifications to definitions and certification criteria to support program measures (e.g., electronic prior authorization), with cross-reference to Health IT Certification criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal To Remove ONC Direct Review and ONC‑ACB Surveillance Attestations
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to remove the ONC Direct Review and ONC‑ACB Surveillance attestations beginning with the EHR reporting period in CY 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Background and rationale provided; affects how hospitals attest to certain ONC certification surveillance and review processes in Promoting Interoperability reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal To Remove the Support Electronic Referral Loops Measures
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to remove the 'Support Electronic Referral Loops by Sending Health Information' and 'Support Electronic Referral Loops by Receiving and Reconciling Health Information' measures beginning with the EHR reporting period in CY 2028.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Background on the Health Information Exchange Objective accompanies the proposal; timing of removal and implications for program objectives are discussed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Updates to the Electronic Prior Authorization Measure
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals to modify the Electronic Prior Authorization measure beginning with the EHR reporting period in CY 2027, including health IT certification criteria to support it, making it a bonus measure in CY 2027, and requiring it starting in CY 2028.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also includes a Request for Information (RFI) on a future potential performance-based measure of electronic prior authorization and specifics on certification criteria needed to support the measure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal To Adopt Unique Device Identifiers for Implantable Medical Devices Measure
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to adopt a Unique Device Identifiers (UDI) for Implantable Medical Devices measure in the Public Health and Clinical Data Exchange Objective beginning with the EHR reporting period in CY 2027.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes background, proposed timeline, and a Request for Information on additional options for utilizing UDI and on a potential performance-based measure using UDI; discusses performance‑based measurement and additional UDI options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of Scoring Methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: An overview section describing the scoring methodology used across related CMS programs and models.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the methodological framework for calculating scores (e.g., composite scores), which inform payment adjustments and reconciliations; detailed method appears in program-specific sections (e.g., CJR‑X Composite Quality Score).

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of Objectives and Measures
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level overview of program objectives and the individual measures used to assess performance under those objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as an index of objectives/measures; detailed descriptions, measure specifications, and reporting requirements are provided in later subsections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Quality Measurement for Eligible Hospitals and CAHs Participating in the Medicare Promoting Interoperability Program
rubrics_metrics.description: Background and proposals regarding clinical quality measurement (eCQMs) for eligible hospitals and CAHs participating in the Promoting Interoperability Program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes proposals to adopt and remove eCQMs, and to modify eCQM reporting and submission requirements, with summaries of previously finalized and newly proposed eCQMs available for reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal To Adopt and Remove eCQMs; Modify eCQM Reporting and Submission Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific proposals to add or remove electronic Clinical Quality Measures (eCQMs) and to change the requirements for eCQM reporting and data submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes timelines for adoption/removal and burden estimates; affects which measures hospitals must report and how they submit data to CMS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Changes to the Transforming Episode Accountability Model (TEAM)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed TEAM provisions including episode definitions, proposed changes to spinal fusion episode category and episode attribution, and TEAM quality measure methodologies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers episode design, measurement performance periods, and proposed baseline period methodology changes specific to TEAM.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Revision to Provider‑Based Location Criteria (Off‑Campus Facilities) (§ 413.65)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed revision to the 'same patient population' location criteria for provider‑based status applicable to off‑campus facilities or organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes background and the proposed regulatory revision text; affects provider-based billing eligibility and compliance with § 413.65.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Expansion of the Comprehensive Care for Joint Replacement (CJR) Model (CJR‑X)
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview and requirements for expansion of the CJR model into the Comprehensive Care for Joint Replacement Expanded (CJR‑X) model, including participant definitions, beneficiary population, episode structure, quality measures, scoring, pricing, and payment methodology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed subparts cover scope, proposed participants and exceptions, beneficiary notification, episode clinical dimension and definition, items/services included/excluded, episode duration and termination, and interrelation with other CMS models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed CJR‑X Quality Measures (specific measures listed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed quality measures for CJR‑X, including: Hospital‑Level Risk‑Standardized Complication Rate (RSCR) following elective THA/TKA (CMIT #350); Hospital Visits Within 7 Days of HOPD Surgery (CMIT #344, OP‑36); HCAHPS (CMIT #338); OAS CAHPS (CMIT #162); Hospital‑Level THA/TKA PRO‑PM (CMIT #1618).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes background on selection of measures and specifics on measure IDs and intended measurement constructs; reporting and performance period details are in Quality Measure Reporting subsection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Measure Reporting (CJR‑X)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for display of quality measures and performance periods, and data submission criteria for CJR‑X quality reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies how measures and performance periods will be displayed and the data submission standards applicable to participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Composite Quality Score (CQS) — Overview and Calculation
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of the Composite Quality Score: overview, determining quality measure performance, quality improvement considerations, and the method for calculating the CQS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how individual measure performance translates to composite scoring and how the composite score affects payment (e.g., reconciliation/discount adjustments).

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Pricing and Payment Methodology for CJR‑X
rubrics_metrics.description: Framework for CJR‑X pricing and payment including target price construction: baseline period for benchmarking, regional target prices, services beyond an episode, episodes spanning performance years, high‑cost outlier cap, trending prices, discount factor, special considerations for low volume hospitals, and preliminary target prices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also contains subsections on risk adjustment, normalization, and detailed steps for computing target prices used in reconciliation and payment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk Adjustment and Normalization (CJR‑X)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals for risk adjustment and prospective normalization factors to be applied when constructing target prices and assessing participant performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key to ensuring fair comparisons across providers and accurate benchmarking in pricing methodology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Process for Reconciliation (CJR‑X)
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed reconciliation process proposals: annual reconciliation, timing, handling participants experiencing reorganization events, updating preliminary target prices to create reconciliation target prices, applying the Composite Quality Score to reconciliation target prices (including adjusting the discount factor), calculating Raw Net Payment Reconciliation Amount (NPRA), limitations on NPRA, participant responsibility for increased post‑episode payments, and reconciliation payments and repayments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes formulaic steps and constraints that determine final reconciliation payments and obligations for participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Appeals Process (CJR‑X)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed appeals process including notice of calculation error and reconsideration request procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the procedural steps for participants to challenge reconciliation calculations or other determinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concurrent Participation in Other CMS Models and Initiatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals addressing concurrent participation: background and rules regarding beneficiary participation in multiple CMS models or initiatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies how CJR‑X (and other models) interact with existing CMS demonstrations and how overlapping participation is managed for beneficiaries and providers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Arrangements (CJR‑X)
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview and proposed requirements related to financial arrangements: CJR‑X collaborators, sharing arrangements (general requirements, gainsharing and alignment payment conditions and limitations, documentation requirements), distribution arrangements (general and requirements), downstream distribution arrangements (general and requirements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also addresses beneficiary incentives (technology provided, clinical goals, documentation of engagement incentives), enforcement authority, and fraud and abuse waiver and OIG safe harbor authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Waivers of Medicare Program Requirements (CJR‑X)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed waivers including post‑discharge home visits, telehealth flexibilities, and waiver of the 3‑day SNF rule with additional beneficiary protections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the scope of the waiver proposals and enumerates additional protections (e.g., under SNF 3‑day stay rule waiver) required to safeguard beneficiaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Sharing Requirements (CJR‑X)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed data sharing provisions: legal authority to share beneficiary‑identifiable claims data, content and format of summary and raw beneficiary‑identifiable claims data reports, minimum necessary data, regional aggregate data, timing/period of baseline and performance year data, and content required in the CJR‑X Data Sharing Agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies what data participants must share, the legal bases, and what contractual/data use agreement elements are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative Payment Model (APM) Options
rubrics_metrics.description: Background and proposed APM options for participation, including a financial arrangements list and clinician engagement list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides potential APM pathways and lists of applicable financial/engagement arrangements relevant to model participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard Provisions and Termination Provisions for CJR‑X
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard contractual and program provisions and proposed termination rules for CJR‑X.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers general terms, grounds/procedures for termination, and post‑termination obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconciliation of Organ Acquisition Costs for Non‑Renal Organs for IOPOs and HCLs
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to reconcile non‑renal organ acquisition costs for Independent Organ Procurement Organizations (IOPOs) and Histocompatibility Laboratories (HCLs), including background, reimbursement approaches, and discussion of stakeholder comments (supportive comments, effects on procurement, costs for perfusion, losses due to nonallowable costs, burden, financial concerns).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses how organ acquisition costs would be reconciled and reimbursed for IOPOs and HCLs, and notes stakeholder input received in response to prior RFIs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasonable Cost Payment Policies (IOPOs/HCLs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed reasonable cost payment policies covering prudent buyer principles; rules for entertainment and OPOs' public education/outreach; activities for employees and non‑employees; alcoholic beverages; professional education and travel (including OPO professional education costs); and meals provided to employees and non‑personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seeks to clarify what costs are allowable/reimbursable and to codify limits and principles for cost allocation and reasonableness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarification and Codification of Cost Allocation Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals to clarify and codify principles governing cost allocation for providers and related entities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aims to make explicit how costs should be allocated across functions and programs for reimbursement purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discretionary CMS Administrator Review of Appeals Under § 413.420(g) for IOPOs and HCLs
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to create a discretionary CMS Administrator review process for CMS Reviewing Official determinations with respect to appeals under 42 CFR 413.420(g) for IOPOs and HCLs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes technical/conforming changes to § 413.420(g) and proposed effective dates; provides an extra layer of review for certain appeals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical Corrections and Clarifications of CFR Provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed technical corrections and clarifications to regulatory text, including §§ 412.116(c) and 413.404(b)(3)(ii)(A) and (C).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Minor conforming/technical edits intended to correct, clarify, or update regulatory citations and language.

rubrics_metrics.name: MedPAC Recommendations and Publicly Available Files
rubrics_metrics.description: References to MedPAC recommendations and listing of publicly available CMS files (wage data, occupational mix data, provider adjustment factors, wage index files, FY2027 IPPS crosswalks, HCRIS cost report data, provider‑specific files, case‑mix index files, MS‑DRG relative weights, payment impact files, and other supplemental files).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directs stakeholders to datasets and public files used in analysis and rulemaking; these files support evaluation and comment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collection of Information Requirements (ICRs) and Burden Estimates
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement of statutory requirement for solicitation of comments and a detailed listing of Information Collection Requests (ICRs) for numerous programs (Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program; Hospital Value‑Based Purchasing; HAC Reduction Program; Hospital IQR; PCH Quality Reporting; LTCH QRP; Medicare Promoting Interoperability Program; TEAM; CJR‑X; proposals regarding acquisition/reasonable costs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes information collection burden estimates associated with proposed measure adoptions/removals/modifications (e.g., eCQMs, claims‑based measures, electronic prior authorization, UDI measure), and summaries used to calculate burden.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Comment Submission Procedures and Deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions and requirements for submitting public comments: refer to file code CMS‑1849‑P; comments must be received by April 10, 2026 (5 p.m. EDT) to be assured consideration; methods accepted are electronic via Regulations.gov, regular mail to CMS P.O. Box, or express/overnight mail to CMS address; CMS will not accept comments by facsimile (FAX).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests commenters to choose only one submission method; provides addresses and instructions for viewing public comments in the SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection and Posting of Public Comments (Privacy and Content Policy)
rubrics_metrics.description: CMS will post all comments received before the close of the comment period on Regulations.gov, subject to redaction or withholding of submissions (or portions) at the agency's discretion; CMS will not post comments that threaten individuals/institutions or suggest harmful actions, and encourages avoiding duplicative comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes that CMS may redact personally identifiable or confidential business information and that acceptable comments from multiple unique commenters may be posted even if content is identical or nearly identical.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plain Language Summary Requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: In accordance with 5 U.S.C. 553(b)(4), a plain language summary of the rule is available at Regulations.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides accessible summary information for stakeholders unfamiliar with regulatory drafting conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of CMS IPPS/LTCH Tables and Contact for Access Issues
rubrics_metrics.description: IPPS and LTCH tables referenced in the proposed rule are available on the CMS website (links provided); contact Michael Treitel (DAC@cms.hhs.gov) for problems accessing tables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides stakeholders to the data tables underpinning rate and policy proposals and provides technical assistance contact information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive Summary — Purpose, Legal Authority, and eCQM Adoption
rubrics_metrics.description: Executive summary stating the proposed rule's purpose and legal authority: revise Medicare hospital IPPS for operating and capital costs; make changes to GME, LTCH PPS, and hospital quality programs; propose to adopt the Advance Care Planning eCQM in the Hospital IQR, PCH QR, and Medicare Promoting Interoperability Programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarizes scope of proposals and highlights key measure adoption (Advance Care Planning eCQM) for multiple programs.
